correctness.rationale: The PGF follows by normalized geometric summation, and its positive compound-Poisson coefficients follow from \(q<t<r\). A fully reconstructed thinning-residual argument proves necessity and sufficiency of the canonical defect nonnegativity conditions, rather than relying on an unproved citation. Strict convexity gives the exact two neighboring minimizer indices, including the boundary at index 1. The explicit asymptotic construction shows no universal finite cutoff; exact fractional computations in checker.py reproduce the PGF, jump and defect identities for 375 rational parameter cases and delayed failures for four increasing scales. Finite experiments are explicitly supplementary.

value.rationale: For the naturally parameterized two-component geometric-mixture count family, an infinite set of structural thinning constraints has an exact two-evaluation decision procedure. The monotonicity-defect failure block has complete geometry, while delayed failures show that testing any fixed number of initial jumps can miss genuine non-self-decomposability. This nonroutine finite characterization distinguishes ordinary thinning self-decomposability from already known compound-Poisson status, and directly applies to two-regime count laws.
